title: Inspect and extend: Test the model and define the network boundary
objective: Use the real implementation in `test/feed.test.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve node test coverage, pure-model boundaries, and absent protocol integration.
problem: A good boundary makes the core easy to test without a phone or server. Read tests as examples of the intended contract, then compare README claims with imports and runtime code to identify what is absent. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `test/feed.test.ts` and the related project files: test/feed.test.ts; README.md; package.json.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to node test coverage, pure-model boundaries, and absent protocol integration.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: No AT Protocol login, moderation, network feed, or remote post creation is implemented.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A good boundary makes the core easy to test without a phone or server. Read tests as examples of the intended contract, then compare README claims with imports and runtime code to identify what is absent.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `test/feed.test.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
